final: WITH driver_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_records FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_records) AS avg_records FROM driver_counts) SELECT driver_counts.driverId, driver_counts.qualifying_records AS count, 1.0 * driver_counts.qualifying_records / average_count.avg_records AS ratio FROM driver_counts CROSS JOIN average_count ORDER BY ratio DESC, driver_counts.driverId LIMIT 10
